title: DNLU JusTech Conclave 2026: Supreme Court and High Court Judges Discuss AI in Judiciary
description:
- The DNLU JusTech National Conclave on November 21, 2026, gathered Supreme Court and High Court judges, advocates, and students to discuss AI's role in the Indian judiciary.
- Justice Joymalya Bagchi emphasized that technology should aid, not replace, human judges, while Justice Alpesh Y. Kogje highlighted the need for equal access to justice amid digital reforms.
- Concerns were raised about AI-generated fake judgments and the risks of algorithmic bias during discussions led by legal experts.
- The conclave underscored the importance of maintaining human reasoning at the core of judicial processes as technology continues to evolve.
